events.title: DX11 compatibility mode available
events.summary: I have heard your feedback and added a separate build that will be available when you hit Play. This will prompt you with both versions. Standard Play Aftermath Z: Red Pine Lake is DX12 for newer systems and DX11 mode which is for older systems. This will offer an FPS boost for older systems and should now work on more systems overall.I am sorry for the rough start and I really hope this helps more people to be able to join in and give better performance. Please do not use DX11 on newer systems

events.title: I took a risk
events.summary: I took a risk. I knew the demo had bugs, I knew I hadn't had the time to test it properly. I knew personal issues had gotten in the way which should have meant me cancelling Next Fest this year and that first impressions matter. But this is a pre alpha, I cannot make the game better if I don't fix it and get peoples thoughts on what is broken.
